line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

verification.scope: Fresh baseline hash, filtered source difference and logical line check; prior compiler controls cited in decision. No production change or new runtime test.

decision: R2332: original USER PCH compile needs CSR private types and ntos.h. R2333: 440 original lines implement nine DDEML data-manager entries including the thin ApplyFreeDataHandle forwarding into InternalFreeDataHandle. Those operations consume private DDEML instances, validated handles and manager locking; original compile control rejects PCL_INSTANCE_INFO and EnterDDECrit. The retained WOW data-release path is not the DDEML handle manager. Keep both boundaries pending; no new implementation of data-handle ownership.
